scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @token/provider-contract && npm run build --workspace @token/commandcode-model-catalog && npm run build --workspace @token/provider-commandcode-private && npm run build --workspace @token/provider-commandcode-goat && npm run build --workspace @token/application-control-plane
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:root && npm run build --workspace @token/desktop-shell
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @token/provider-contract && npm run typecheck --workspace @token/commandcode-model-catalog && npm run typecheck --workspace @token/provider-commandcode-private && npm run typecheck --workspace @token/provider-commandcode-goat && npm run typecheck --workspace @token/application-control-plane && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @token/desktop-shell
scripts.test:inner: node --test test/certification/*.test.mjs && vitest run && npm test --workspace @token/desktop-shell
scripts.test:release:inner: node --test test/certification/*.test.mjs && vitest run --maxWorkers=4 && npm test --workspace @token/desktop-shell
scripts.test:online-responses:inner: npm run build:packages && tsx test/online/run-commandcode-private-responses.ts && tsx test/online/run-commandcode-goat-responses.ts && tsx test/online/run-opencode-go-responses.ts
scripts.test:online-anthropic:inner: npm run build:packages && tsx test/online/run-commandcode-private-anthropic.ts && tsx test/online/run-commandcode-goat-anthropic.ts && tsx test/online/run-opencode-go-anthropic.ts
scripts.test:online-claude:private:inner: npm run build:packages && tsx test/online/run-claude-cli.ts --provider commandcode-private --model commandcode-private/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash --api-key-file CommandcodeAPIKey.txt
scripts.test:online-claude:goat:inner: npm run build:packages && tsx test/online/run-claude-cli.ts --provider commandcode-goat --model commandcode-goat/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash --api-key-file CommandcodeAPIKey.txt
scripts.test:online-claude:opencode-go:inner: npm run build:packages && tsx test/online/run-claude-cli.ts --provider opencode-go --model deepseek-v4-flash --api-key-file OpenCodeAPIkey.txt --alias opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash
scripts.test:online-codex:inner: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix onlinetest/codex_cli test --
scripts.test:online-claude:inner: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix onlinetest/claude test --
scripts.test:distribution:inner: npm run build && node --test test/distribution/*.test.mjs && npm test --workspace @token/desktop-shell && npm run test:product-e2e:run --workspace @token/desktop-shell
